label: explained

reasons.text: The whole order value distribution moved right (AOV ₹1,885 → ₹3,110, rest-of-range median +53%) with no separate high-value cluster. That matches fashion's order-value-led festive pattern.
The 'Buy 2 festive sets, 25% off' offer went live the hour the spike began, and FESTIVE25 appears in 71% of spike orders. The bundle explains the larger baskets.
Influencer reel mentions surged 6 hours before volume rose, so demand led payments rather than following them.
62% new customers is consistent with a promoted sale, and there are no repeated card or device clusters among them.
14 months of Account Aggregator inflows give a merchant-specific baseline, and the only complaint is a delivery delay.

merchant_message: Your festive sale looks healthy and matches your FESTIVE25 bundle offer. We recommend releasing 80% of settlements on the normal schedule, with 20% held for 30 days while the dispute window passes.
